Name: Azriel, Head of Manasseh
Summary: Head of the house of Manasseh's fathers, a mighty man of valour.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 5:24: Head of the house of Manasseh's fathers, a mighty man of valour.
LifeLesson: The mention of Azriel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
